title: Atlas 10-room spherical concept review
status: qualified concept preview; desktop and mobile runtime checked

rooms.label: Hall B · stage & production
rooms.source: five-BIGRTWO (historic exhibition view; Hall B assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Corrected stage is at the window wall; inter-hall opening and flank doors are visible. Minor seam/floor joins and polar texture artifacts remain. Stage/screen dimensions, table positions and clearance are not verified.

rooms.label: Hall A · coding & support
rooms.source: five-BIGRONE (historic exhibition view; Hall A assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Coding groups and support activity. Visible small rear seam step and polar texture pinching. Functional concept only; exact furniture layout, capacities and shirt palette are unverified.

rooms.label: Registration foyer
rooms.source: three-OUTBALLONE (historic source; event-function assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Check-in furniture consolidated into the existing lounge bay; central exits and thresholds appear clear. Fine details are soft, the floor pole is mildly distorted and some exit-sign lettering changed. This is not approved signage or a measured layout.

rooms.label: Rest & wellness
rooms.source: three-BALLROOM2 (historic source; event-function assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Representative cot banks with blue/white pillows and blankets, adults and care support. Clear broad central/door routes shown. Minor carpet pinching and seam/texture changes; the optional massage-chair pocket was omitted. Cot totals and occupancy are not validated.

rooms.label: Judges & VIP lounge
rooms.source: six-C456 (historic source; event-function assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Gray lounge groups and guests in the combined meeting-room source. Minor seam/pole artifacts. Fourteen sofas were requested, but exact count, SA-50/SA-21 shape fidelity and room fit are not verified.

rooms.label: Covered dining
rooms.source: four-OUTWED1 (historic source; event-function assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: A modest dining group occupies a side pocket; front/rear covered walkway stays clear. Minor roof/paving pole pinching and seam-texture change. Food/water station and yellow helper were omitted to preserve circulation.

rooms.label: Private meeting
rooms.source: six-3F (historic source; event-function assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Original boardroom furniture with four judges/leads, notebooks and water. Apparent door access is clear. Minor seam/panel alignment and pole/carpet distortion; optional whiteboard omitted.

rooms.label: Small-business hub
rooms.source: one-INDROOM (historic source; event-function assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: One demo table, two display backdrops, bistro discussion and small platform/screen. Door approaches visually cleared in correction. Fine ceiling-grid shimmer, seam drift and curved nadir tiles remain. Actual fit and capacity unverified.

rooms.label: Exterior arrival
rooms.source: seven-OUTBIGROOM (historic source; event-function assignment is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Restrained blue/white banners and arrow boards, sparse arrivals and security. Open plaza and original arcade retained after removing invented planters. Visible brick-pattern warp at the exact floor pole, softer detail, sky drift and slight tonal joins remain.

rooms.label: Meeting lounge · accepted proof
rooms.source: six-C6EMPTY (historic meeting-room view; lounge use is conceptual)
rooms.notes: Four illustrative sofas. This is the accepted visual-direction proof, not the fourteen-sofa VIP fit plan. Small carpet pinch at nadir, faint zenith texture artifact and minor seam discontinuity.

sourceMethod: Each complete six-face original photograph was converted into one equirectangular sphere before geometry-preserving imagegen edits. Not independent generated angles.
browserVerification: All ten views passed desktop Chrome, Chrome native mobile touch and mobile WebKit; original image artifacts and fit limitations remain.
sourceExportVerified: 42 source cubefaces plus two metadata files passed SHA256 verification.
viewerImprovements: Status moved inside information card to avoid mobile control overlap
Canvas accessible label changes per room
One WebGL texture reused across room switches
roleColours: Participant royal blue; other role colours are provisional October2025 references, not a confirmed current-event palette.
